earned_scope: G5/L5 exact source/operator/input/product assessment; material nuclear-rate evidence only with complete licensed inputs. This closes the assessment question, not the full LENR parent objective.

mechanism_assessments.citation: Del Giudice, Preparata, Vitiello, PRL 61,1085-1088 (1988), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.61.1085; pp1085-1087 Eqs(1)-(18),(29)-(34); original PDF pages1-4 inspected.
mechanism_assessments.source_operator: Molecular rigid rotor L_j^2/(2I) plus A dot d_j in the paper notation (A denotes electric field, not the material vector-potential coordinate); impurity term -d_j dot E_d. Nuclear transmutation operator: not defined in this water model.
mechanism_assessments.medium_operator: Electric dipole orientation field psi(u,t) and transverse radiation modes a_r(k,t); long wavelength and rotational l=0,1 truncation, resonant modes only.
mechanism_assessments.inputs_normalization: Natural units hbar=c=1. I=2 m d_g^2, |d_electric|=2 e d_e; source water molecular distances, not Ni parameters. Integral dOmega |psi|^2=N; psi=sqrt(N) xi, integral dOmega |xi|^2=1; a=sqrt(N)b. Rotational |l,m> and transverse polarization r are not nuclear spin/level labels.
mechanism_assessments.material_entry: Prepared electronic density/current and ionic coordinates can characterize a different Ni/H collective response with explicit units. They cannot be inserted as the water dipole, inertia or molecular rotational-state population without a derived material projection.
mechanism_assessments.products: Molecular polarization/radiation energy exchange; no nuclear daughter, nuclear Q, branching or heat mechanism specified.
mechanism_assessments.missing_prerequisite: For any nuclear use: specify actual Ni/H nuclear initial/final states and transition operator, its coupling to a measured/prepared medium observable, normalization and matching quantum numbers. Water polarization alone supplies none.
mechanism_assessments.assessment: Source/operator mapping complete; this is not a nuclear reaction model and is not a no-go for mechanisms outside this Hamiltonian.

mechanism_assessments.citation: Bressani, Del Giudice, Preparata, Nuovo Cimento A101,845-849 (1989), DOI 10.1007/BF02844877; pp847-849 Eqs(1)-(12), original PDF pages1-5 inspected.
mechanism_assessments.source_operator: Screened radial dd entrance potential Vprime(r)=alpha/r [1-(Z/2) r^3/delta^3], Eq(4); WKB penetrability D, Eq(6). The proposed 4He* to 4He transition is represented by prescribed oscillating electric field E, Eq(8), followed by electron-plasma excitation amplitude A(t), Eq(9). The intrinsic nuclear transition-current/multipole matrix element is not supplied with normalized nuclear states.
mechanism_assessments.medium_operator: Collective charged-species plasma oscillation: omega_p=e sqrt(N/V)/sqrt(m), Eq(1); electronic displacement scale delta=(2 m_e omega_ep)^(-1/2), Eq(3); coherent deuteron domain lambda_dp=2pi/omega_dp, Eq(7); coherent electron excitation driven by Eq(8). Electron-count enhancement N_e appears in Eq(9).
mechanism_assessments.inputs_normalization: Source hbar=c=1, frequency quoted in cm^-1, distances cm/fm, rates s^-1, power density W/cm^3. N/V is metal atom density where used in Eqs(2),(7)-(12), Z participating electrons per atom, f deuterons per atom, mu dd reduced mass, D dimensionless penetration probability. Eq(8) uses omega about24 MeV, typical internal deuteron velocity |v|=0.1; these are source assumptions, not material measurements. Need actual nuclear J^pi/isospin/multipole, spatial form factors and continuum normalization; these are not fixed by plasma phase coherence.
mechanism_assessments.material_entry: Density/ionic/field derivatives and prepared response could test a Ni/H electronic screening or a specified collective susceptibility after deriving the matching operator and domain normalization. A static density, a Gamma current, or low-energy finite-q response does not establish the nuclear-frequency current or coherent volume used in Eqs(8)-(10).
mechanism_assessments.products: Source dd -> 4He* -> 4He with proposed electronic energy transfer, competing ordinary nuclear channels; p849 also mentions pd -> 3He. Source rates/power Eqs(10)-(12) are not imported as results. These D-bearing entrances are not Ni+2p and require an actual D inventory.
mechanism_assessments.missing_prerequisite: Specimen D and entrance preparation; microscopic screened entrance valid down to nuclear matching radius; normalized nuclear states/current and allowed multipoles; actual high-frequency longitudinal/transverse medium response and losses; spatial phase/coherence boundary, emitted products and finite absorber transport. The prescribed field/typical velocity does not determine a Ni receiver matrix element.
mechanism_assessments.assessment: Exact source proposal mapped, including its explicit phenomenological amplitude rather than claiming no amplitude is written. No reproduction or verification of its WKB enhancement or quoted rates is asserted.

mechanism_assessments.citation: Y.E. Kim, PNMBTG-6-2011 (June18,2011), Generalized Theory of Bose-Einstein Condensation Nuclear Fusion for Hydrogen-Metal System, pp2-4 SecsII-IV, reactions(i)-(iv); https://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/KimYEgeneralize.pdf; original four-page PDF inspected.
mechanism_assessments.source_operator: Entrance even-A Ni plus proposed two-proton spin-singlet composite, A=58,60,62,64. Exit channel labels (i) Cu(A+1)+p, (ii) Ni(A-2)+alpha, (iii) Zn(A+1)+n; d,3He,t exits also discussed. The 2011 text does not give a normalized antisymmetrized Ni+p+p channel transition amplitude or Hamiltonian coupling to a Ni/H medium observable; referenced earlier mixture theories are not silently substituted.
mechanism_assessments.medium_operator: Assumed mobility/overlap of Ni nuclei and paired protons producing two-species Bose condensation. Required observable is a spin-resolved two-proton reduced density matrix with relative-coordinate dependence, population/lifetime and correlation with Ni positions, not electronic one-body density or classical ionic covariance.
mechanism_assessments.inputs_normalization: Pair S=0 (antisymmetric spin) requires symmetric spatial exchange sector; opposite spins alone do not establish a bound or long-lived pair. Need normalized pair and Ni continuum/condensate states, number density and ensemble, nuclear J^pi/isospin, channel angular momenta, Coulomb/centrifugal matching and partial widths. No physical pair size, contact probability, lifetime, occupation or transition amplitude units/normalization are supplied by this paper; a chosen convention must be stated before a rate can be calculated.
mechanism_assessments.material_entry: Prepared electron state, ions, forces, field/current and finite-q response can constrain the material preparation and test screening/collective motion. Ionic zero-point/trap covariance does not perform proton antisymmetrization, establish pair ODLRO, or determine nuclear exchange/capture; existing classical positions cannot be relabeled a nuclear condensate.
mechanism_assessments.products: Use the existing AME2020/NUBASE2020 12-channel Ni+2p product ledger, not the paper's older Cu decay values. Gamma/neutron observations, isotope changes, charged particles, recoil and weak-decay leptons remain distinct. A proton spectator cancellation in atomic Q does not make the correlated amplitude equal to binary capture.
mechanism_assessments.missing_prerequisite: Physical two-proton spin/spatial preparation and Ni isotope state; channel-resolved nuclear interaction/matrix elements and matching between material and nuclear length/energy scales; branch/level feeding; calibrated medium coupling if energy goes to the medium; emitted spectra and finite-geometry transport.
mechanism_assessments.assessment: Source/operator/input/product assessment complete with an exact amplitude/preparation gap. Not a rate, zero-rate theorem, or proof/disproof of the wider BECNF program.

mechanism_assessments.citation: Reused measured-nuclear-channels-001.json and its authenticated Simon arXiv1305.1213 p3 TablesI-II and Lopez-Saavedra arXiv2601.22262v2 p2 TableI; AME2020/NUBASE2020 bindings in nuclear-product-energy-ledger.json.
mechanism_assessments.source_operator: Measured inclusive ordinary Ni(A)(p,gamma)Cu(A+1) and Cu59(p,alpha)Ni56. Cross sections are empirical entrance-flux-normalized observables, not complex amplitudes or multipole-resolved nuclear operators. The two-step network is an explicitly incoherent sequential model, not a Ni+2p coherent matrix element.
mechanism_assessments.medium_operator: Response/state-matched proton encounter flux for each separate collision and intermediate-state population/decay/stopping; not a density/current fluctuation spectrum alone.
mechanism_assessments.inputs_normalization: Measured effective CM energies MeV, cross sections mb with uncertainties/upper limits retained. Required matched flux cm^-2 s^-1 yields per-target hazard; initial isotope counts and duration s then feed the existing network. Ground-state/unpolarized and finite experimental energy-response qualifications must match; no interpolation/extrapolation to thermal energies. Nuclear phases/multipoles and exclusive spectra are not recoverable from inclusive cross sections.
mechanism_assessments.material_entry: Composition and a physically justified entrance energy/flux distribution could license a binary channel calculation on the acquired experimental responses. Existing electron/ion preparation provides no such MeV proton flux. Nuclear decay and stopping inputs remain separate.
mechanism_assessments.products: Captured gamma/cascade and Cu recoil; successful second collision alpha+Ni56 then Ni56/Co56 weak decay chain; competing Cu59 decay. Existing exact energy telescoping and isotope topology reused. Total sequence Q cannot be assigned as one two-body emission or as heat.
mechanism_assessments.missing_prerequisite: Two actual matched encounters, incoherent ground-state reduction and competing-channel closure, specimen inventory, branch spectra and transport. The measured source Q discrepancy remains explicit; AME controls Q.
mechanism_assessments.assessment: Measured-channel and conditional network capability already earned; no replay and no invented material rate.

limitations: Conditional initial electrons, not equilibrium or experimental temperature.
Force and onsite blocks use declared geometric covariance with retained saved-geometry residuals.
H0 diagnostics are original-source only; initial common-Hamiltonian drift includes K(delta n) and is not set to zero.
Linear ionic coefficient is the accepted A27 finite scalar; frozen ionic curvature is the A22 finite sum. Their different alpha/cutoffs are retained, not claimed identical finite-Ewald derivatives.
Frozen q curvature is not electronically screened phonon response; no ASR/Hermitian repair.
Ionic and field quantum preparation, coupled trajectory and coherence claim remain separate.
prepared_reference.nuclear_use: Prepared electronic/ionic reference and screening/force inputs only; neither nuclear pair wavefunction nor nuclear transition operator.

limitations: Original source-state and selected density/gradient checkpoints do not establish full material equilibrium
H0 source-state result remains pending; no H0 stationarity assertion
No actual full-grid trajectory or equilibrium/FDT claim
No automatic Hermitization, clipping, tolerance certification or q-support repair
Cq and populated full-grid mean must be supplied for response trajectories

field_moments.normalization: full spin/mesh mean; slot weight applied exactly once
field_moments.correction_scope: fixed-state zero-field nonlocal scalar only; no SCF or finite-field ionic join
field_moments.joint_scalar_limit: Zero-field nonlocal correction joins the A25 scalar only at fixed prepared density and zero field; does not establish transported H0, moving-density SCF consistency, finite-field ionic derivatives, self-consistent response, or an ionic/field quantum state. No anchored undressed constant is called gauge-covariant.
field_moments.nuclear_use: Zero-field prepared moments, not a stationary nuclear-frequency spectral density or a radiative continuum.

normalization_contract.electrons: Independent spin/mesh sectors; explicit slot weights, raw Gram/factor occupations, no extra degeneracy. Density bohr^-3, physical grid pairing dv in bohr^3.
normalization_contract.ionic: All 37 atom-order xyz coordinates (111); u bohr, positive density gradient Ry/bohr, unmassweighted Cq Ry/bohr^2, Kq maps density bohr^-3 to Ry; time tau=t Ry/hbar.
normalization_contract.field: Uniform periodic q=0 a=e A_SI/hbar in bohr^-1, Pi canonical; electric field E_Ha=-da/dtau/2. This vector-potential A is not DPV1988 electric-field A. No cavity frequency, nuclear receiver or vacuum inferred.
normalization_contract.statistics: A response/commutator is not automatically an unsymmetrized fluctuation spectrum. A moving prepared state need not be stationary or obey equilibrium FDT.

material_input_assessment.not_claimed: Whole many-region dynamics/comparison or a complete nuclear-frequency correlator; these are distinct from the component receipts consumed here.

step_energy_equations: E_gamma_cascade + T_Cu_recoil + E_Cu_exc = Q1_atomic + E1_CM + delta_electronic_1
T_alpha + T_Ni_recoil + E_Ni_exc = Q2_atomic + E2_CM + delta_electronic_2
Each equation uses its OWN CM frame. Lab totals require supplied momentum transformations and intermediate transport; E1_CM+E2_CM is not automatically one global incident energy.
Weak Q_EC endpoints separately feed neutrinos, EC relaxation or positrons/annihilation, daughter recoil and cascades; subtract 2*m_e*c^2 for each beta+ kinetic endpoint.
sequential_energy.not_a_two_body_partition: The successful net route retains capture photons; do not partition net Q solely between alpha and Ni56.

ordinary_measured_channels.decay_scope: NUBASE inclusive isotope topology; beta+/EC split, nuclear feeding and photon/neutrino spectra remain unspecified
missing_inputs: Ni+2p antisymmetrized channel-resolved transition amplitude or justified material reduction to sequential binary dynamics
Ni intrinsic spin-momentum receiver matrix elements, widths and state/phase conventions
Actual isotope/state preparation and two distinct proton encounter distributions in the Ni/H material
Intermediate stopping, cascade/state population, competing reactions and transport/deposition including neutrino/photon escape

source_gaps: Nickel (028) is absent from both official PSTAR and ASTAR material selectors; no neighboring-element substitution or invented nickel ion table.
STAR does not provide heavy Ni/Cu/Zn recoil-ion or positron stopping in these acquired tables.
No Ni/H compound-specific energy-absorption coefficient or charged-product stopping table acquired; elemental mu_en additivity is formally incorrect (NIST chap3).
primary_table_limitations: NIST photon tables omit photonuclear interactions, nuclear-resonance and Delbruck scattering; important photonuclear contributions can occur in the 5-40 MeV giant-resonance region.
Near-edge chemical/phase/temperature fine structure is absent from these elemental photon tables. Hydrogen STAR material is the source gas medium, not interstitial H in nickel.
Interpolation is an explicit table-transfer approximation, not a material-model fit or a reproduced native NIST interpolation.
missing_material_inputs: Exclusive emitted spectra/branch populations and matching actual reaction rates, not inclusive cross sections or AME Q alone.
Measured finite sample geometry, source position/direction distributions and Ni/H composition/phase; periodic 4^3 lattice is not an absorber.
Secondary photon and charged transport, containment and thermalization; compound-specific coefficients where needed.

bridge.flow: Licensed entrance/transition -> exclusive isotope/state branching and emitted energy/momentum spectra -> consistent atomic/electronic Q and recoil budget -> existing conditional photon/charged/explicit-unresolved transfer. Only measured event rates plus thermalization/escape closure could convert per-event accounting to power.
bridge.no_new_energy_execution: This consumer reuses already published Q, channel and NIST receipts. It does not rerun parsers, networks, kinematics or transport oracles and does not insert a synthetic emitted spectrum.

formal_conditional_bridge.status: Conditional mathematics only, never a model asserted for Ni/H or for any cited paper.
formal_conditional_bridge.definition: H_int=sum_mu N_mu tensor B_mu plus Hermitian conjugate as needed, with energy units and explicit initial nuclear/medium density matrices. At weak coupling, stationary factorized initial state, continuum/long-time golden-rule limit and specified nuclear transition amplitudes, S_E,mu,nu(Delta)=sum_b,bprime p_b conjugate(B_mu[bprime,b]) B_nu[bprime,b] delta(Delta-(epsilon_bprime-epsilon_b)) and Gamma=(2pi/hbar) sum_mu,nu conjugate(n_mu) S_E,mu,nu(Delta) n_nu.
formal_conditional_bridge.units: For dimensionless B, n has energy units, S_E has inverse-energy units, Delta=E_i-E_f is nuclear energy release and positive Delta excites the medium. With S_omega=int dt exp(i omega t)<B_mu^dagger(t)B_nu(0)>, S_omega=2pi*hbar*S_E(hbar omega); Gamma=n^dagger S_omega(Delta/hbar)n/hbar^2. No FDT/equilibrium assumed from a moving prepared state.
formal_conditional_bridge.not_available: No physical n_mu, chosen matching medium B_mu, stationary nuclear-frequency spectral measure, continuum justification or irreversible-rate limit supplied. This formula does not extend the material energy window or manufacture a receiver.
formal_conditional_bridge.finite_witness: Fixed two-level nuclear entrance |i>, exit |f>, arbitrary dimensionless B and normalized rho_B. Set T=g |f><i| tensor B, H=T+T^dagger, H0=0. The exact unitary short-time final-population coefficient is |g|^2 Tr(B rho_B B^dagger)/hbar^2. The same rho_B/B admits distinct coefficients when g changes. It is not a stationary rate or physical Ni operator.
oracle_registration: SymPy direct full Kronecker-space double commutator gives the t^2 coefficient independently of the reduced trace expression; asymmetric complex B and nonuniform diagonal rho expose ordering/conjugation defects.
Exact spectral sum of transition weights equals Tr(B rho B^dagger); nondegenerate rational medium energies retain signed absorption/emission support.
Changing g to 2g with fixed medium changes the coefficient by four; mutation discarding nuclear coupling must fail.
Mutation using transpose rather than adjoint and mutation using rho B B^dagger rather than B rho B^dagger must fail on the same asymmetric fixture.
Golden-rule prefactors/energy-frequency conversion checked symbolically; mutations reversing Delta support or dropping hbar must fail.
SHA256 mismatch mutation on byte admission and omission of a required published receipt must fail before report construction.

new_oracle.kind: formal finite-dimensional witness, NOT material prediction
new_oracle.meaning: Same medium state/operator, different nuclear couplings, different transition probability coefficients. Neither an irreversible rate nor a value for Ni/H follows.
new_oracle.golden_rule_limit: Energy/frequency normalization checked only; stationary continuum, weak coupling and physical nuclear matrix element applicability are NOT established by this finite example.

scope_decision.N_assessment: Complete exact source/operator/input/product assessment with missing prerequisites as its legitimate observable; not held open solely for absence of a material nuclear rate.
scope_decision.after_D_and_C: Even an executed collective material response and matched controls do not supply pair preparation, a channel-resolved nuclear amplitude, nuclear-frequency matching or exclusive product spectra. Those require external physical inputs/construction, not rerunning D/C.
scope_decision.full_LENR_parent: Not completed: predictive isotope-resolved nuclear rates, measured products and finite-sample thermal power still require the listed physical inputs.
scope_decision.logical_limit: No missing operator is equated to a universal no-go or an actual zero physical rate.
